name: grt-group-shopcore-v2
description: ShopCore ERP repository root. frontend/ and backend/ stay independent npm projects with their own lockfiles; this package only delegates to them.

scripts.install:all: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.typecheck: cd frontend && npm run typecheck && cd ../backend && npm run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.db:setup: npm run prisma:migrate && npm run prisma:seed
